summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K updating ATM sales for the week August 10–16, 2026. MSTR common stock sales totaled 3,458,866 shares with net proceeds of $333.7 million; preferred stock sales were zero. Proceeds were allocated to STRC dividends, STRC repurchases, and increasing its USD Reserve for bitcoin purchases. Available issuance capacity remains $21.7 billion for MSTR and various preferreds. This is a routine ATM utilization update, not a special situation.
